How many employees does Aurora Solar have?
Aurora Solar, Inc. has approximately 239 total employees worldwide as of June 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data. Aurora Solar’s total headcount has declined 62.7% from 641 employees in 2023 to 239 in 2026.
Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026
Is Aurora Solar hiring right now?
Yes, Aurora Solar is actively hiring. Aurora Solar had 35 active job postings in 2026, a 141.5% increase from 2025 — see job openings & hiring trends.
About Aurora Solar’s Workforce
Aurora Solar, Inc. is an Information Technology Services company that employs 239 people worldwide as of June 2026. It is the 7th-largest by headcount among its peers. Founded in 1981, the company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
Aurora Solar's workforce has declined 62.7% from 2023 to 2026, down 10.7% year over year in 2026. It fell to a low of 239 in 2026 Q2 before recovering. Its workforce is concentrated most in North America (84.9%), followed by Southeast Asia (4.4%) and South Asia (3.9%).
Aurora Solar's functional groups are Finance and Operations (48.2%), Engineering (37.8%), and Sales and Marketing (14.0%). The average salary is $162,634, ranging from a median of $340,000 in Western Europe to $12,000 in South Asia, up 1.9% year over year in 2026.
Aurora Solar's active job postings rose 141.5% in 2026 to 35, with new postings per month cooling from 14 in 2023 to 9 in 2026. Overall employee sentiment is neutral but improving.
